He says that he could make something new and fresh if only you would bring him #b10 Cold Eye Tails#k... You hope it comes out tasty! \n\n#i 4000023##t 4000023#  #b#c 4000023#/10#k

yes.0: This time, I'll cook with Cold Eye Tail. The Evil Eye Tail and Curse Eye Tail weren't that great, but I have a good feeling about the Cold Eye Tail! So, please get me #b10 Cold Eye Tails#k.

no.0: Do you not trust my cooking skills? That's disappointing.

1.1: Oh wow... these tails are cold just like the name suggests. I'm going to mix it with milk and freeze them for a nice Ice Cream Pop. Hmmm... This is not bad, but I don't want to make it again.
